name: 727-83-disk-growth-forensics
note: REQUEUE - 2026-09-09 17:15 PT. Previous run c521618a produced NOTHING in 3 rounds and the cause was NOT scope, so do not cut it. Its own prompt outgrew the model: manager 829,358 chars (~207k tokens), executor 715,695. Rounds 1-2 could not emit a valid route; round 3's executor emitted no readable output - which is what a prompt that size looks like from the inside. Two contributing faults, both now understood: (1) the task-94 defect - role_history_chars is applied TWICE, so history alone can reach 200k chars; (2) the launcher was putting THREE concurrent runs on the local Ollama span, which serves about ONE executor. FIXED IN THE LAUNCHER 17:15: LOCAL_CAP was only enforced inside the Synthetic-down fallback block, so trios 0 and 1 kept seating a local executor in normal mode with nothing capping them; it now rotates to an all-Synthetic trio when the span is full. This requeue should draw a non-local executor. IF IT AGAIN PRODUCES NO EXECUTOR OUTPUT, stop and report - do not requeue a third time. || ORIGINAL: Paxton 2026-09-09: forensic 'why did space grow / is it typical'. READ-ONLY on live hosts. Distinct from task 75 (capacity plan) - do not duplicate.
